description: NetLogo Agent-Based Model on energy poverty in the switch to a heat network in Delft is a model or code deposit deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Julian van Loo (Delft University of Technology). Agent-based model to explore inequalities in energy poverty and access to energy of households as a result of the switch to a heat network in specific neighbourhoods in Delft. Developed as part of a master's thesis in Industrial Ecology. Zip file includes the NetLogo code and required input data files. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1234654 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
